delta.reasoning_content:
The exports contain 6,620 records across 42 histories. I’m reviewing them in bounded, provenance-preserving batches, including inactive/compacted records and queued owner corrections.

The original Hermes exchanges show two distinct issues: incomplete end-to-end execution, then genuine admission failures. Later receipts must determine which failures remain current. Source, installed helpers, and historical implementations are being compared separately; no runtime operations are being replayed.
